description: A pixel-art octopus in the sidebar that acts out what Claude Code is doing, one per agent. Unofficial, not affiliated with Anthropic.
config.scope.description: Which Claude Code sessions make the octopus move.
config.scope.all: React to every Claude Code session on this computer.
config.scope.workspace: React only to sessions started in the folders open in this window.
config.showInExplorer: Show the octopus in the Explorer sidebar.
config.showInSourceControl: Show the octopus in the Source Control sidebar.
config.showInRunAndDebug: Show the octopus in the Run and Debug sidebar.
config.showInTesting: Show the octopus in the Testing sidebar.
